verdict.rationale: The GST help pages document registering as a taxpayer, with a two-part (Part A / Part B) registration application and the option to generate a User ID on a temporary basis. This implies an entry path for people who are not yet registered. None of the cited pages explicitly says the flow can start without creating an account, and none documents a keyless or reference-number entry step. missing for 10: explicit documentation that the registration/filing flow starts without login, a description of the keyless or file-number (e.g. temporary reference) entry mechanism, step-level detail, and independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As a founder, I can start the core online flow without creating an account first — the service's published pages document a keyless or file-number entry path

citations.quote: Know how to register with GST as a taxpayer or generate a User ID on temporary basis.
